title: Growth Yield, Nutrient Limitation and Environmental Factors
method: Count whitespace-delimited words in visible teaching paragraphs before Part B, excluding figures, tables, headings, UI and practice; article includes headings, captions, tables, revealed answers and references, excluding SVG and enlargement buttons.
comparator: 2.A.02 reports 11,569 narrative words and 2.D.10 reports 7,560 in the existing checkpoint; 2.E.04 has 14,080 narrative words with broad resource, yield, energetics and environmental treatment, not a length-only gate.
scientific_checks: Visually verified revised merged NET Unit 2.E p.3, separate CSIR Life Sciences Unit 2.E p.2 and archived MP SET 2024 p.2. Reviewed Bauchop–Elsden, Pirt, Lipson and OpenStax. First self-review corrected volume-basis explanation, oxygen sensitivity and pH context; second strengthened carbon accounting, ATP yield basis, storage-vs-division and supplementation inference and refined cardinal temperature curve. Recalculated 0.45, 2.40, 2.55, 1.275, 0.367, 50%, 1.2, 0.3, 0.5, 1.155, 1.733, 3, 4, 5 and 1000; checked practice calculations, all original hypothetical data and questions. No reactor design or detailed stress regulation.
limitations: Two substantive editorial self-reviews, not external human review. Static source, geometry and arithmetic checks only; no interactive browser/device or full accessibility audit. MP SET is an archived 2024 copy, not a verified current MPPSC-hosted original. Both immediate neighbors were unpublished at baseline; their links remain disabled. Live Pages verification separate and pending.
